The decisive mistake was the first answer. The MarineBiology_Expert's step 0 result gave 57,000, estimated by interpolating from 2022 data. It did not use the Wikipedia page as it stood on January 1, 2021, which gives 56,000.

The later steps did not correct this. The Verification_Expert only described how to use the Wayback Machine and then said 57,000 "stands valid." The Statistics_Expert scraped the live page, which is not the 2021 version. That page showed 56,583, which also rounds to 57,000.
